messages:
emma: FYI deploybot blocked the publish for search-indexer:v5.4.2 — flagged a manifest rewrite between gcr and ecr mirrors.

deploybot: publish blocked for `search-indexer:v5.4.2`
reason: manifest digest mismatch across registries (gcr.io/redwood/search-indexer -> sha256:f1f2... ; registry.redwood.io/search-indexer -> sha256:d4d5...). refusing automatic promote to avoid serving an unintended manifest.

chris: when did the mirror pipeline start re-writing manifests? I thought we preserved digests.

dave: mirror job was changed last month to gzip layers for bandwidth savings — that can change manifest digests. we didn't flag it as "rewrite-unsafe".

emma: we need this in staging for the indexing canary tomorrow. can we do a manual-safe flow?

infra: recommended safe steps (copy by digest, verify attestations, pin):
```
# fetch canonical digest from source registry
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/search-indexer:v5.4.2 --format='get(image_summary.digest)'
# copy by digest preserving manifest content where possible
skopeo copy \
  docker://gcr.io/redwood/search-indexer@sha256:f1f2... \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/search-indexer:promote-1778888888 --preserve-digests
# verify cosign attestation on the copied digest
cosign verify-attestation gcr.io/redwood/search-indexer@sha256:f1f2...
# pin deploybot to digest
deploybot set-pin --service=search-indexer --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/search-indexer@sha256:f1f2...
```

chris: add a pre-pin `cosign verify-attestation` step in the PR. also include a tiny health-check script that hits the indexer API.

emma: rollback criteria: if staging p50 indexing latency increases >150ms or error rate >3% in first 10m, revert pin and delete the staging tag. keep a 20m change window at 01:00 UTC.

qa-bot: will run the `staging-provenance-check` suite after pin. note: tests include indexer integration smoke and cosign verify.

dave: I'll open the PR with the skopeo copy, cosign verify, deploy pin, health-check, and a revert script.

emma: also open a ticket to mark the mirror job as rewrite-unsafe and add a lint that blocks unqualified tag promotion when identical tags exist across rewrite-unsafe prefixes.

dave: filing ticket: https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/INF-8732 — add detection and tag-blocking.

chris: once PR is up, ping me and @emma. i'll approve and run during the 01:00 window.

emma: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/1489 — includes promote-by-digest, cosign verify, revert script, release-note blurb explaining why we used a staging-qualified digest. tagging @chris @dave @qa-bot

deploybot: note: automatic promote remains disabled for events where mirror rewrites are detected. manual intervention required.

emma: thanks — running the promote during the window and will update this thread with results. :thumbsup:
